newsitem.title: USA: No US Senate vote on Commerce nominee Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: No US Senate vote on Commerce nominee Wednesday.

text.p: The Senate will not vote on William Daley's nomination to be secretary of the Commerce Department until at least Thursday, Assistant Majority Leader Don Nickles, R-Oklahoma, said Wednesday.

The Senate Commerce Committee approved Daley's nomination Wednesday morning by a 15-1 vote, clearing him for a vote by the full Senate. Nickles said a Senate vote on Daley might come on Thursday morning.
The Senate Wednesday confirmed Andrew Cuomo as secretary of Housing and Urban Development, 99-0.
